name: Aster
description: Aster is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures and spot trading, with order books running on Aster Chain, its own privacy-focused layer 1 for derivatives. The app takes deposits from BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana and Sui.
description_zh: Aster 是一个去中心化的永续合约与现货交易所，订单簿运行在其自有的、注重隐私的衍生品一层链 Aster Chain 上。应用接受来自 BNB Chain、以太坊、Arbitrum、Solana 和 Sui 的存款。
chains: Aster Chain, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, Sui

geo_site.method: POST /bapi/futures/v1/public/future/web3/common-check-ip returns {isBlocked, orderLimit, country}: isBlocked refuses the wallet connection ("Service not available in your region"), orderLimit leaves only closing positions and withdrawals. The countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: isBlocked in BY, CD, CU, IQ, IR, SD, SS, SY, ZW; orderLimit, that is close-only, in the US); the Terms name 11 Prohibited Jurisdictions.

tos.restricted: Prohibited Jurisdictions: US, Canada, UK, China, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Cuba, Iran, Venezuela, Syria

notes: Closed frontend. The IP check is a public API call the app makes before connecting a wallet; the answer names the country but the mapping of countries to isBlocked and orderLimit is server-side. The IP check answered isBlocked:false and orderLimit:false from Singapore, Brazil and France on 2026-10-12.
